title: From the shack window
logline: The dock from inside the shack, through the window, at dusk: three figures in three chairs from behind, small, the bay, the last light. The page stands where Gully's daughter would, and doesn't draw her either.

panels.composition: Through a shingle shack's window from inside: three small figures in three chairs on a dock from behind at dusk, the bay beyond, the window's frame and a corner of the corkboard.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, seen through a shack's window from inside, three small figures seated in three chairs on a dock from behind at dusk with the bay beyond, the window frame and a corner of a corkboard, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
